title: phaseolus vulgaris var. ceromelas
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. ceromelas, commonly known as scarlet runner bean, is a variant of the common bean plant. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Phaseolus vulgaris var. ceromelas include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, control blood sugar, and aid in weight management, due to its high fiber and protein content. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
